web_api.title: Connect Web API provider
web_api.description: Choose a unique local provider ID. The connection is tested before the hub is saved. Connection and authentication data may be reused by other hubs.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure provider hub
reconfigure.description: New connection and authentication data are saved only when every linked system remains present and produces valid entity values. Leave password empty to keep the saved password.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate provider hub
reauth_confirm.description: The new password is saved only when every linked system remains present and produces valid entity values.

A duplicate system’s local source mapping is fixed. Unlink the system and link a new duplicate system to change that mapping. Changing the system ID does not rename existing entity IDs.

archive_week.name: Archive week
archive_week.description: Archive a completed calendar week for enabled source archives or one selected system. With no week specified, catch up on missing completed weeks. Files are stored on the HA system.

week.name: Calendar week
week.description: Optional ISO week, for example 2026-W35. Completed weeks only, from Monday 00:15.

device_id.name: Solar boiler
device_id.description: Leave empty to archive all solar boilers owned by enabled Solesta integration entries.

archive_failed.title: Solesta week archiving failed
archive_failed.description: One or more weekly archives or registry journal records could not be saved or verified. Check Archive status on the system device and the Home Assistant log. Existing archives are retained. Automatic archiving will retry.

archive_recorder.title: Check Recorder for Solesta archives
archive_recorder.description:
Reliable weekly archives need all system entities recorded; at least 21 days of detailed history is recommended. The integration does not change your Recorder settings.
